events.title: Playtest Patch Notes 0.9.5
events.summary: 1. Fixed the issue where the basic attack of the "Summon Sword" at 4th and 5th hits would teleport through certain walls. 2. Fixed an issue where the game would automatically skip the storyline when restarting from the same save after death. 3. Added a 1-second internal cooldown for passive ability triggers. 4. events.title: Playtest Patch Notes 0.9.1
events.summary: Fixed a bug where Spinning Slash could sometimes launch the player into the air. Added volume settings for environmental sound effects. Fixed a bug where Flying Swords could occasionally target shielded enemies and orbit them. Fixed an issue where flying enemies kept rising even when frozen or under time-stop. events.title: Ruins of the Titan is joining Debut Festival 2025 on Steam!
events.summary: Proud to announce that Ruins of the Titan is joining Debut Festival 2025 on Steam!Date: Aug 7–11 Huge thanks to gamedev.ist for this honor! Can’t wait to be alongside so many amazing first-time devs!Step into a world plunged into chaos after the fall of the creator god — and battle your way through gods, awakened races, and shattered faiths in this 2D pixel art action Roguelike.
